question: Which country is set to host the 2026 Commonwealth Games after Victoria, Australia, withdrew due to high costs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scotland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• **Scotland, backed by its government, is set to host the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow with £100 million invested by the Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF) and £2.3 million from Commonwealth Games Australia.**
